client.business_model: Physician-led, multi-site dermatology practice network providing medical, surgical and cosmetic dermatology care across New England.
client.client_history: Founded in 1992 as a solo dermatology practice, APDerm has expanded through acquisitions and de-novo openings to become the largest physician-led dermatology network in New England.

revenue.notes: Public estimates vary widely: LeadIQ $2.7M (2025), Growjo ~$44.7M, Owler $25-100M range. No official figure available; highest specific estimate (Growjo) used but reliability is low.

locations.notes: Release states APDerm 'operates 32 locations throughout Massachusetts, New Hampshire, and Rhode Island'. Company overview page later mentions 'over 40 locations', indicating growth; 32 is the last concrete count.

employees.notes: Headcount estimates range from 105 (Clodura) to 501 (LeadIQ) and 501-1,000 (Indeed). Mid-range figure of 205 selected; lack of concordance yields low confidence.

extraction_sources: Agreement/Procurement Cost Reduction Services Agreement_APDerm_12.11.20 - signed.pdf (page 1)
Businesswire press release 2021-10-12 (APDerm Opens 6th Office in New Hampshire)
extraction_notes: Official legal name verified from executed services agreement: 'Adult & Pediatric Dermatology, PC'.
PE ownership confirmed in multiple places: case study overview and Apex-Partners summary of Waud Capital investment (2017).
Revenue, employee and location figures are based on third-party estimates; no audited or company-reported numbers were located, leading to lower confidence.
No EBITDA information found in any document or web source.
